traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text:
The shadow hunter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception)
checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.text:
While in dim light or darkness, the shadow hunter can take
the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6
(1d6 + 3) piercing damage and 10 (3d6) poison damage. The target must
succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour.
